tools.name: find_argo_brand
tools.description: Locate an Argo Group brand or region on argogroup.com. Returns a working URL, or explains that the brand’s landing path redirects and its pages must be found through its sitemap index.

brand.description: Brand or region name, e.g. "Rockwood" or "Argo Surety". Leave empty to list all.

tools.name: get_agent_resources
tools.description: List the machine-readable agent-discovery resources published by argogroup.com.

tools.name: get_claims_route
tools.description: Return the correct Argo Group claims resource for a claim enquiry. Does not file claims.

claim_type.description: e.g. automobile, property, crime, workers compensation, medical billing, blackboard
